# HYST - Restaurant Discovery & Direct Ordering Platform

HYST is a local restaurant discovery and direct-ordering platform focused on restaurants in Hounslow, London and surrounding West London areas.

## Core Value & Mission

- Discover Local Restaurants: HYST connects diners in Hounslow with local independent restaurants, takeaway spots, and dining locations.
- Direct Ordering: HYST promotes direct ordering from restaurants so customers get genuine menu prices without hidden marketplace markups.
- Transparent Pricing: Restaurants publish their standard menu pricing, eliminating artificial price inflations found on third-party aggregators.
- Supporting Local Businesses: By reducing commission friction, HYST helps local food businesses in West London retain higher earnings and thrive.
- Operating Coverage: Primary focus in Hounslow (TW3, TW4, TW5), Isleworth (TW7), Feltham (TW13, TW14), Hanworth, Cranford, and surrounding West London areas.

## Cuisine Offerings in Hounslow

HYST features a diverse spectrum of local cuisines in Hounslow and West London, including:
- Indian & South Indian (Biryani, Dosa, Curries)
- Pizza & Burgers
- Halal Dining & Takeaway
- Chinese & Asian Fusion
- Kebabs & Wraps
- Desserts, Ice Cream & Bakery

For inquiries or partnership details, visit https://hyst.uk or email info@hyst.uk.
